population: All 100 previously fixed confirmation poses, one physical start per pose; no exclusions by reachability or outcome
start_assignment: Even pose index: seven-joint zero; odd pose index: assembly preset. 50 each, fixed before this run.
original_sampling: Six-dimensional Latin hypercube, seed 20261012; reused, not a new blind holdout
physical_installation: Default Demo: assembly (0.3,0.2,-0.25) m, yaw pi, arm_base_z=0
success: Best-effort Q contract: complete approach/alignment/insertion/lift/P, validated optional Q and final dwell, full uncached revalidation
full_q: Separately count Q=0 -> +90 -> 0 -> -90 degrees; partial Q remains an accepted best-effort plan
denominator: Exactly 100 per backend, including initial collision, IK failure, deadline and audit failures
seed_policy: Online generation only; no saved per-pose solutions or cross-request warm start
compute: CPU-only, empty CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, backend CPU affinity 0 and 2, one numerical thread per process
artifacts: Successful and failed trajectory CSVs, source/binary/suite hashes, logs rotated at 1 MiB with two backups
cleanup: Runner reaps its planner child on normal and exceptional completion; retain inputs, trajectories and results; no renderer or shared memory created
